wikipediaArticleRead.support: The Elah section at L2355 says Elah was the father of Shimei, a Solomon commissary, and cites 1 Kings 4:18. This supports the named commissioner at 4:18; it does not establish that he is the unnamed-patronymic Shimei of 1:8.

sourceTextExcerpts.text: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;
But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
